name: agent-ssh-solo
description: Tier-P F1 solo scenario: install ONLY agent-ssh on a fresh box and assert its STANDALONE transport-provider contract. agent-ssh owns SSH profile emission, reachability/read helpers, and the pluggable transport module contract; it must not require agent-worktrees, agent-bridge, agent-codespaces, or any other sibling plugin to provision, expose a binstub with a real version, or answer idempotent read verbs. Name-free / public.
validates: Installing agent-ssh alone writes its marketplace payload and does not pull sibling plugins.
The runtime provisions from a fresh session / login-shell binstub trigger, with installer provision as the continuation fallback.
~/.local/bin/agent-ssh is on a stock login-shell PATH and prints a real non-empty version.
Standalone read verbs for the SSH transport-provider contract exit 0 without any live SSH target or sibling plugin.

stages.title: runtime provisions on first session / first use
binstub on PATH + reports a REAL version
STANDALONE: read verbs answer with no sibling plugin
